note: 已完整读取目标 frank-lloyd-wright 正文+FAQ。实际原句 “some accounts credit Hall with quietly doubling the reinforcing himself, others credit Kaufmann's consulting engineers with redrawing Wright's plans.” 。源句 The dome most visitors assume is a pure Michelangelo design is, on the building's own records, a collaboration finished by two other architects making their own calls, comparable to [the additional reinforcing used during Fallingwater's construction despite Wright's objections](/frank-lloyd-wright/). 。核读Hall8→16钢筋建议和不同加钢人员记述、Glickman承认负筋遗漏、2002Silman修复；源现指施工额外钢筋，不再错称Wright工程师偷偷添加。

已完整读取目标 mona-lisa 正文+FAQ。实际原句 “The 1911 theft did not rescue the Mona Lisa from obscurity” 。源句 The most quoted line about the building's most photographed bronze object may be describing the wrong metal, much the same kind of afterlife a theft gave [the Mona Lisa's fame](/mona-lisa/), where the popular story and the documented one don't quite match. 。核读含1907guidebook、1911盗窃、1913回收、大众传播，目标不支持盗窃前完全无名；源句只类比流行故事与记录差异，不将两起事件因果等同。

已完整读取目标 sagrada-familia 正文+FAQ。实际原句 “Construction started on 19 March 1882” 。源句 [Barcelona's Sagrada Família](/sagrada-familia/) inverts that same problem: a project begun in 1882 whose later builders have worked from Gaudí's surviving models and reconstructed plans. 。核读1882原Villar设计、1883Gaudi接任、1936模型毁损、重建模型与现工程；源已去整座2026竣工和同世纪，采用1882起建/后人重建设计记录。六中央塔外部完成与整座竣工混淆已由官方和Vatican报道确认，下一批目标自身同步窄修。
